Alameda 县从 ACOE 学校与学区目录及地图开始；Contra Cost: In Alameda County, start with ACOE's school and district directory and map; in Contra Costa County, use CCCOE's district directory to reach district websites. Check the district boundary with the full street address, then use that district's School Locator for individual schools. Elementary, middle and high schools may be served by different districts. City names, ZIP codes and property-site labels do not replace verification. Ask the enrollment office about new streets, boundary addresses or unclear map results.

新生、转校和看校分开办理: Handle enrollment, transfers and school visits separately
核验时 Berkeley、Mt. Diablo 和 San Ramon Vall: At review, Berkeley, Mt. Diablo and San Ramon Valley provided 2026–27 enrollment entry points; recheck the calendar for the next school year. New families should use official lists for residency, age and educational records and submit documents only through official channels. For a school change within a district, check intradistrict procedures; across districts, check interdistrict procedures with both districts for permits, seats and decision timing. A submitted application is not a completed assignment.
从学区学校目录进入校方网站预约看校，问语言与学习支持、课程、课后照护和实际接送。: Use the district's school directory to reach school websites and book visits. Ask about language and learning support, classes, after-school care and transport. Obtain permission before entering a campus. If standard residency documents are missing or interpretation is needed, ask enrollment staff about alternative verification and support; do not send documents to strangers.
大学与社区学院，不按 K–12 学区分配: Universities and community colleges do not use K–12 assignment
UC Berkeley 从本科申请页区分 first-year 与 transf: UC Berkeley separates first-year and transfer applicants on its undergraduate application page. Its visit page links to tours and admissions presentations, with separate booking checks. Peralta's enrollment page lists Berkeley City College, College of Alameda, Laney and Merritt: explore each campus and its courses, choose a college, complete enrollment, then register for classes in Campus Solutions. County directories list additional community colleges. Check college eligibility, teaching locations, costs and visits separately; local residence does not establish admission or free tuition.
